theorem: The W33 triangle complex has beta1=240-rank(d1)-rank(d2)=81 with rank(d1)=39 and rank(d2)=120 over GF2. Odd-triple incidence has full vertex rank 40, while the edge-support map separates triangle triples, whose boundary vanishes, from one-edge triples, whose boundary is a two-vertex open edge. This gives a chain-complex explanation of the closed/open split seen in the Hashimoto T/O decomposition.
